newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Virginia ISD #706, Minn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Virginia ISD #706, Minn..

text.p: General Obligation School Building Bonds, Series 1997A
Proposals for the Bonds will be received at the offices of Springsted Incorporated, 85 East Seventh Place, Suite 100, Saint Paul, Minnesota on
until 12:00 NOON, Central Time, after which time they will be opened and tabulated. Consideration for award of the Bonds will be by the School Board at 6:00 P.M., Central Time, of the same day.

Proposals may be submitted in a sealed envelope or by fax (612) 223-3002 to Springsted. Signed Proposals, without final price or coupons, may be submitted to Springsted prior to the time of sale, as described more fully in the Terms of Proposal. Proposals may also be filed electronically via PARITY, in accordance with PARITY Rules of Participation and the Terms of Proposal.
The Bonds will be dated March 1, 1997, as the date of original issue, and will bear interest payable on April 1 and October 1 of each year, commencing October 1, 1997.
The Bonds will mature April 1 in the years and amounts as follows:
The District may elect on April 1, 2005, and on any day thereafter, to prepay Bonds due on or after April 1, 2006, as described more fully in the Terms of Proposal.
For copies of the Official Statement or for any additional information prior to sale, any prospective purchaser is referred to the Financial Advisor to the District,
Springsted Incorporated, at the above address, telephone (612) 223-3000.
By Order of The School Board
